audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven rows disagree with both the packet chart and this page's own prose: rows 1-5 read Sion or Skill while whys[1] through whys[5] all describe Maokai out-trading him, and row 6 reads Sion while whys[6] says the lane goes even.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Skill / Maokai / Maokai / Maokai / Maokai / Maokai / Skill, Maokai wins 56.05% here, and Sion is immobile against a 14s Twisted Advance.
audit.corrected: Rows 1-5 to Maokai and row 6 to Skill, as one atomic group with matched content pairs and ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes present: the 2-3 W-Q window, level 6 Nature's Grasp as gank setup, the first-item grind, and Sion's early charged-Q threat.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page treats Decimating Smash as an on/off stun and never states the two rules that decide the lane: it only knocks up and stuns at full charge, and Soul Furnace is a shield that reactivates after 3 seconds to deal damage.
audit.why: Riot's Q text: 'If he charges for enough time, enemies hit by the swing will also be knocked up and stunned.' Riot's W text: 'Sion shields himself and can reactivate after 3 seconds to deal Magic Damage to enemies nearby.' Q is 10s at rank 1, W 15s, E 12s.
audit.corrected: Charge rule, the 3s Soul Furnace detonation and real cooldowns written into tldr, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[1].d and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.why: Sion has no escape, so Twisted Advance plus a long Nature's Grasp is genuinely premium gank setup — the existing jungle line and whys[4] already say so.

edits.before: Dodge his Q — W-root into Q, out-sustain his early. Maokai wins the Decimating Smash cooldown windows.
edits.after: Decimating Smash only stuns at full charge — step in on the wind-up and W-root before the release (10s).

edits.before: Charged = knockup. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Only a full charge stuns — sidestep the arc and it is 10s wasted.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Soul Furnace detonates 3s after the cast — trade once it has popped.

edits.before: - Sion Decimating Smash: matchup-defining — Charged = knockup. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Sion Decimating Smash (10s at rank 1): stuns only at full charge — sidestep the arc, then W-root. - Soul Furnace (15s) detonates 3s after the shield goes up: fight after it pops. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

notes: Six chart rows proposed as one atomic group across both layers; they now match packet.levelChart, the 56.05% win rate and the existing whys. Did not assert whether Unstoppable Onslaught is unstoppable through Bramble Smash's knockback or whether Nature's Grasp terrain stops the charge — neither is in Riot's text, so both stay unstated.
